name: Andrzej Halicki, Matjaž Nemec - Après le § 67 - Am 145/1
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2026
part_text: 67 a. Underlines that appropriations for the Southern Neighbourhood line need to support efforts to tackle illegal migration, notably by enhancing border protection and facilitating return and readmission; stresses that Union funds must be conditional upon effective cooperation on migration management and return; recalls that Union funding must only be implemented by partners that ensure full transparency, neutrality and accountability; notes with concern credible reports that UNRWA staff were involved in the terrorist attacks of 7 October 2023, and stresses that Union funds must not be channelled through organisations whose staff are implicated in acts of terrorism or incitement to violence; emphasises that it is not the task of the Union to reconstruct Gaza, and that regional partners are better placed to do so; expresses concern about the situation in Syria, with special regard to the protection of Christian and other religious communities facing attacks by extremist groups, and underlines that Union assistance to Syria must protect all religious communities and support an inclusive, democratic transition guaranteeing constitutional rights for all;
